title: Add unified LLM adapter module

context.summary: Centralize current and future LLM provider usage behind one reusable Mindory module.
context.background: API and worker runtime currently construct OpenAI-compatible and Ollama embedding providers directly. Future subsystems need one configurable component that can support multiple providers and OpenAI-compatible OAuth bearer tokens supplied by a host such as Codex or Hermes.

in: Add a shared @mindory/llm workspace package as the runtime adapter boundary for LLM/embedding providers.
Support disabled, OpenAI-compatible and Ollama embedding providers through the shared module.
Support OpenAI-compatible auth modes for no auth, API key and externally supplied OAuth bearer token.
Move API query embeddings and worker document embeddings to the shared LLM module.
Replace old MINDORY_EMBEDDINGS_* runtime configuration with MINDORY_LLM_* configuration.
Document the unified LLM adapter and update configuration/deployment docs.
out: Implement an interactive OAuth browser/device-code flow.
Add paid external provider requirements to default checks.
Implement generative chat usage where no subsystem currently needs it.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm is the single runtime construction point for current LLM/embedding providers.
API and worker runtime no longer instantiate OpenAI-compatible or Ollama providers directly.
OpenAI-compatible OAuth bearer token mode is represented in config and adapter code.
Old MINDORY_EMBEDDINGS_* env names are removed from active runtime configuration.
Docs explain how subsystems should use the shared adapter.

manual_checks: Confirm API/worker imports point at @mindory/llm for provider construction.
Confirm OpenAI OAuth mode does not require storing a raw token in docs or examples.

risks: Changing config names requires updating demo, strict indexed acceptance and documentation together.
OAuth support can sprawl into interactive login; keep this task to externally supplied bearer tokens.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
